## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

A 12-juan Mid-Qīng *biji* by Zhōu Zhào, taking its title from the author's residence at Twin-Bridge (*Shuāngqiáo*). Provenance and composition date unrecorded; the catalog meta gives no dates. The work covers conventional Mid-Qīng *biji* topics — classical interpretation, historical commentary, observations on customs, *Lǐxué*-aligned moral reflection.

**Abstract**

The *Shuāngqiáo suí bǐ* is a comparatively obscure Mid-Qīng *biji*. Composition window unrecoverable; the frontmatter brackets broadly to the Mid-Qīng (ca. 1700–1750).
